limits: not_listed is not an explicit exclusion or removal verdict.
Scope matching does not verify a manually guessed package or an APK download.
Unavailable private/deleted programs remain unresolved; no authentication is bypassed.
A review can confirm scope, reject an attribution, or document an unresolved source.
Paused programs remain indexed when identity and last applicable scope are evidenced.
Bounty and current submission eligibility are separate from inclusion.
Page observations and queued checks are not physical HTTP request counts.
An exhausted visible search is not a complete vendor product inventory.
Source or rate-limit failures retain pending cursors instead of being marked exhausted.

appchina.initial_request_count_note: The first version retained the final page response after local retries, not a full physical request log; stored page observations are not HTTP request totals.
appchina.safety_change: Shared first-429 circuit breaker, per-request global pacing, explicit network_attempted flag, no IP/identity switching.

myapp.evidence: Observed SearchList React component maps a single itemData array and has no app pager; dynamic layout offset addresses cards, not individual apps.

baidu.pagination_contract: Observed frontend fetchData appsearch uses pn and hasNextPage; follow until false; validate returned pn and repeated sets.
baidu.detail_contract: Requested resList d_ID.html main appDoc; canonical docid may differ from historical requested docid, recommendations excluded.

verdict: Incomplete: measured source coverage, with explicit unresolved and inaccessible scope.

limits: Market searches cover visible results for recorded queries, not every vendor product.
Baidu follows pn/hasNextPage to the observed end; QQ developer SearchList is non-paginated.
AppChina rate limiting leaves unfinished queries; all stop reasons are recorded.
Identity, official scope, rewards and current submissions are reviewed separately; paused programs remain indexed.
